_comment: v14 moments: what a week leaves behind. kinds: weight and a line template ({day} {t} {who} {said} {title} {score} {n} {stars} {which}). weekly: the one sentence, first template whose `when` holds wins (fields from weeklyFacts()).

debt.en: {day}: the balance went negative for the first time

reimb.en: {day}: put a dinner on the grant

inspired.zh: {day}，在植物园走到第三圈时想到了基金的创新点
inspired.en: {day}: the grant's idea came on the third lap of the garden

weekly.zh: 这周你失去了一个学生。其他的事，都排在这后面。
weekly.en: This week you lost a student. Everything else comes after that.

weekly.zh: 这周最重要的事发生在饭桌上：{moment}
weekly.en: The most important thing this week happened over a meal: {moment}

weekly.zh: 你交了基金，也倒下了 {collapses} 次。那之后的几天，你比之前清醒。
weekly.en: You submitted the grant, and collapsed {collapses} time(s). The days after were clearer than the days before.

weekly.zh: 你交了基金，代价是一周只回了 {home} 晚家。
weekly.en: You submitted the grant; the price was {home} night(s) at home all week.

weekly.zh: 这周钱的事比基金的事更难：{moment}
weekly.en: This week money was harder than the grant: {moment}

weekly.zh: 基金没有提交。申报系统周五 23:59 准时关闭，你在 {where} 。
weekly.en: The grant was not submitted. The portal closed at 23:59 on Friday; you were at the {where}.

weekly.zh: 一周 {home} 晚回家，两个截止都赶上了，没人注意到你是怎么做到的。
weekly.en: {home} nights at home, both deadlines met, and nobody noticed how.

weekly.zh: 这一周冒出 {all} 件事，你亲手做了 {done} 件。
weekly.en: {all} things came up this week; you handled {done} of them yourself.
